messages:
emily-eng: Quick Q: I need to be in Tallinn for ~9 weeks to help care for my elderly parent (2026-06-08 -> 2026-08-09). A few things I want to confirm before I submit the Temporary Location form: 1) Will WFH stipend be prorated for 9 weeks? 2) My partner (non-Redwood) may visit; does that affect anything? 3) Do I need to change benefits / add parent as dependent temporarily for travel medical coverage? 4) Ill bring my company laptop and an external drive  any import/export docs or insurance we handle? 5) Any tax/nexus concern for Estonia for 9w? :estonia:

marco-peopleops: Thanks Emily. Short answers: stipend = prorated by calendar days for temporary moves under 90 days; 9 weeks will be prorated. Please submit the Temporary Location form with dates/address and whether devices are carried vs shipped.

marco-peopleops: Parent as dependent: we dont typically change benefits for short temporary stays. Travel medical insurance can be requested as an add-on if youre worried; upload a copy to the form if you buy one.

sara-legal: Tagging in: Estonia follows 183-day residency rules; 9 weeks (63 days) wont trigger residency. However, if youre performing local paid work or representing Redwood in sales/negotiations there can be presence risk. Meeting family/visiting is fine.

toni-payroll: Payroll items: confirm stipend currency preference (USD/EUR). Stipends are processed through payroll and taxed according to your home payroll rules. We dont gross-up for short temporary stays. If you plan to be paid to an EU bank, let payroll know.

it-ops: Device notes: bring company laptop as carry-on if possible, register the serial in IT before travel, enable FileVault and have your YubiKey. For external drives, avoid storing PII. If you want ShipOps to handle shipping, we provide temporary export docs and transit insurance (up to $2k per device). shipops@redwood.com

marco-peopleops: Quick checklist to attach to the form:
- Dates & full address (start_date, end_date)
- Device list (serials, company vs personal)
- Stipend currency preference
- Manager approval (CC)
- Any planned meetings with local companies (describe)
- Travel medical insurance (optional)

ticket-bot: HR case created: HR-12876 "Temporary remote: Tallinn 2026-06-08 to 2026-08-09 (Emily)". Assigned to people-ops/marco.

emily-eng: Thanks all. Ill submit the form today, include device serials and travel insurance quote just in case. Partner is just visiting for a week  not working. CCing my manager after I submit. Appreciate the quick help :heart:
